## Description

Please provide a brief summary of the changes and the motivation behind them.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] CI / Tooling improvement
- [ ] Code refactoring or cleanup

## Verification & Testing

Describe how you tested these changes:
- [ ] Ran unit tests: `make test`
- [ ] Checked formatting and vet: `make lint`
- [ ] (If applicable) Tested against a live NPM instance (see [Lab Instance Guide](docs/lab-instance.md))

## Checklist

- [ ] My code adheres to the existing coding style and formatting (`gofmt`).
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
- [ ] I have updated relevant documentation if applicable.
- [ ] All safety write gates and JSON output modes are preserved.
